review_candidates.title: Backup Recovery Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Administer enterprise backup platforms such as Commvault, Veritas NetBackup, Rubrik, Cohesity, Veeam, or equivalent across physical, virtual, and cloud workloads. Knowledge of ransomware recovery and secure backup practices (immutable storage, air-gap or logical isolation, encryption, MFA/RBAC, least-privilege administration), plus working knowledge of RPO/RTO and disaster recovery concepts.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Hands-on experience with at least one enterprise platform (Commvault, NetBackup, Rubrik, Cohesity, or Veeam) and familiarity with a second platform.
